description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the 'AdvancedConfig' class, which provides methods for configuring and managing advanced system parameters via wrapper functions. It includes functions for initialization, prerequisites setup, parameter get/set, attribute management, object addition/deletion, health checks, session management, and cleanup, all interfacing with external C functions designed for system parameter interaction.

classes.name: AdvancedConfig
classes.description: A class implementing system configuration management functions, interfacing with external C wrapper functions for parameter operations and providing functionalities for initialization, parameter get/set, attribute management, object management, health checks, session control, and cleanup.
